BFA.note: The yearbook is described as the main statistical data of the national statistical system; the document does not say the figures are drawn from administrative records.
The document describes updating the Open Data Platform with yearbook data; it states no open data policy.

facts.fact: INSD says a working session updated the Open Data Platform of Burkina (ODP) to make all data of the 2022 national statistical yearbook available, in reusable formats such as Word and Excel.
